PULSE.meaning: Control Tower pulse identity bound to one Git commit

SOURCE_ARCHIVE.meaning: Immutable private Control Tower source-archive snapshot root over the registry-selected descriptor set and private source heads

QRSPRITE_INPUT.meaning: Private-generated encrypted QRSprite carrying the complete Control Tower input and anchored to the previous public Git commit

QRSPRITE_BOOTSTRAP.meaning: Historical Control Tower bootstrap derived from an already-published encrypted private catalog; never equivalent to ctqr FULL INPUT or MASTER LIVE

QRSPRITE_UPLOAD.meaning: Local SAS-encrypted QRSprite created from manually uploaded Control Tower source-drop data; first digest identifies the plaintext drop, second identifies ciphertext; never equivalent to ctqr canonical private input

TRANSLATION.meaning: SHA-256 of canonical Control Tower translation

invariants: raw hexadecimal shape is never sufficient to infer semantic type
Git commit ids are exactly 40 hex in this contract
ctarc identifies a private archive snapshot and is never a ciphertext, Git commit, QRSprite, or source marker
QRSprite full-input keys bind exactly one previous public commit to exactly one encrypted payload digest
ctqrb historical bootstrap keys can never be substituted for ctqr full-input keys
ctqru local upload keys can never be substituted for ctqr full-input keys or ctqrb bootstrap keys
SHA-256 families are exactly 64 hex but remain semantically distinct
typed keys are additive aliases; legacy raw fields remain for compatibility
